scenario: X08 direct known synthetic submission-ID authorization check
limitations: Only a single known synthetic submission ID was tested.
No response bodies, submission text, credentials or tokens were recorded.
This does not cover attachments, direct downloads, search, exports or list filtering.

test_execution_note.issue: The helper discarded the response body from its first successful login call, then logged in a second time to obtain the token. The second session was tested and logged out; the first session token was not captured and cannot be individually revoked.

session_expiry_basis.source: backend/app/auth.py _SESSION_HOURS at the verified source revision 98b51d74cdf0785970d2d42cb8bb5431ae898046

test_execution_note.remediation: No account-wide session revocation was attempted because it could affect unrelated sessions. The untracked test sessions are expected to expire under the source policy.
